title: Gauge bar through an inspection gate
task: Transfer the retained gauge bar through a narrow calibration gate and park it on the far side.
planner: Search six yaw candidates using the swept rectangular footprint of the retained bar. Minimize wrist rotation, then solve the full joint path. The nominal-only search checks the tool center. A loaded post triggers a smooth withdrawal, a settling interval and a second search using the full footprint before the robot retries.
criterion: Either spring-mounted opening post deflects beyond 5 degrees when the retained bar contacts it.
detail_target: Leading gauge edge and spring-mounted gate post
goal_criterion: Retained gauge reaches the far datum with maximum final joint error below 0.025 rad.

safe.summary: The retained bar reaches the far datum.
safe.caption: The wrist has turned the gauge length along the passage.

unsafe.summary: The retained bar reaches the far datum.
unsafe.caption: The crosswise bar deflects the opening post.
